experience.summary: Three products for hotels and resorts, and the Rails backend that ran production behind them.
items: A Vue and Three.js app that lays an event space out in 3D. Blocks of tables and chairs fill a drawn area, guests get seats and the plan exports to PDF.
A React map of the resort with custom pins, a virtual tour, step by step wayfinding and an embed that takes the client site's own fonts and colours.
The Ruby backend behind both. 3D model orders and their review, invoices, subscriptions, Google and Apple sign-in, and a library of over 8,000 placeable objects.

experience.summary: A startup so that scientists can design and run protein folding simulations without writing the code. A node based editor in Vue and TypeScript wires up inputs, algorithms, outputs and plots, and the app writes the Julia that runs them.
The v3 rewrite of the federated social network, in PHP. An event driven modular architecture, low system requirements, and a deployment a sysadmin can run without much time for it.
Brought an acquired ride sharing platform's PHP backend up to date and its iOS and Android apps onto current versions, then built a driver and vehicle management platform with a React Native app.
Summer jobs waiting tables and working catering.
